decision.explanation: The source documents explicitly support two distinct affiliations for Simon Roessig. Document 1 (D1) describes Simon working at 'Leicester General Hospital' and states he received resources from and embodies the 'University Hospitals of Leicester NHS Trust' (D1S16, D1S20). Document 2 (D2) details his academic career, stating his name is linked to the 'University of Cologne' via research projects, publications, and faculty records (D2S4, D2S11, D2S13, D2S20). Both entities are valid employers/affiliations mentioned in the text, representing different aspects of his career (clinical/research trust vs. academic institution), and should be retained as complementary answers.
